meta.title: Inversión
meta.goal: Crea dramatismo, intensidad y estilo retórico mediante estructuras invertidas con 'So + adjetivo', 'Such + be' y locaciones.

cards.title: Inversión: qué expresa
cards.lede: Crea dramatismo, intensidad y estilo retórico mediante estructuras invertidas con 'So + adjetivo', 'Such + be' y locaciones.

rows.value: So great was the interest that servers crashed within minutes.
Such was the severity of the storm that flights were grounded.
On the top of the mountain stood an ancient fortress.
Enclosed in this envelope is the signed agreement.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: So + adjetivo + verbo be/auxiliar + sujeto + that... · So intense was the competition that prices dropped.
Such + be + sujeto/sustantivo + that... · Such was his determination that he succeeded.
Preposición de lugar + verbo de posición + sujeto · Next to the station stands the headquarters.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: So profound was his influence that an entire generation adopted his philosophy.
Such was the devastation caused by the fire that rebuilding took decades.
Attached to this communication are the revised financial forecasts.
High above the skyline rose the new architectural landmark.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Inversión retórica (C2)
columns.rule: Coloca 'So + adjetivo' o 'Such' al inicio invirtiendo el verbo principal para máxima intensidad
examples: So fierce was the opposition that the law was repealed.

columns.label: Estructura directa (B2)
columns.rule: Mantiene el orden tradicional sujeto + verbo + so/such
examples: The opposition was so fierce that the law was repealed.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: So great the shock was that nobody spoke.
So great was the shock that nobody spoke.
lines.note: En la inversión con 'So + adjetivo', el verbo 'was' debe preceder al sujeto 'the shock'.

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: Usa 'So + adjetivo + be + sujeto' ('So impressive was the demo').
Usa 'Such + be + sustantivo' ('Such was the noise that...').
Tras adverbios de lugar ('Down came the rain'), el verbo principal antecede al sujeto si es un sustantivo.
Si el sujeto es un pronombre, no se invierte ('Away he ran', NO 'Away ran he').

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: ___ was the urgency of the situation that an emergency meeting was called.
quiz.explain: 'Such + was + sustantivo (the urgency)' expresa la intensidad del sustantivo.

quiz.q: So complex ___ the technical challenges that the project took three years.
quiz.explain: 'So + adjetivo (complex)' requiere el verbo de estado en plural 'were' para concordar con 'challenges'.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál de las siguientes oraciones presenta la inversión de lugar correcta?
options: At the center of the debate lies the question of ethics.
At the center of the debate the question of ethics lies.
At the center of the debate does lie the question of ethics.
At the center of the debate lie it the question of ethics.
quiz.explain: Tras la locación inicial, el verbo de posición ('lies') antecede al sujeto ('the question of ethics').
